metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Herminie, PA
metaDescription: Mineral owner near Herminie, Westmoreland County? We buy oil, gas, and royalty interests in this former coal-patch community along Sewickley Creek. No pressure.
heroLead: Herminie was built as a coal-patch town along Sewickley Creek, and like most patch towns, its mineral history is a lot more layered than a quick look at the surface suggests.
intro: Herminie grew up as a company coal town, and while the mines are long closed, the deed history they left behind is still very much part of how mineral rights get sorted out in this part of Westmoreland County. Coal, oil, and gas were often severed into separate ownership here decades before Marcellus was ever drilled.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Herminie, whether you're dealing with a modern gas lease, an old severed interest from the coal era, or a fractional share passed down through family.

sections.heading: A former coal-patch town's gas history
paragraphs: Patch towns like Herminie were centered on specific mines, and the surrounding farmland often had its coal rights sold off separately from oil and gas long before anyone drilled a well here. That means the coal severance and the oil-and-gas severance can be entirely different transactions with different owners and different dates.

sections.heading: What that means for a title search today
paragraphs: When we review a Herminie-area tract, we're careful to confirm which historical severance actually covers oil and gas rather than coal, since the two are frequently confused in family recollection even when the deeds are clear on paper.

sections.heading: Value depends on the specifics
paragraphs: Whether your interest is producing, leased, or open, and what the underlying lease actually says about royalty and post-production costs, all shape what we can offer — we look at your documents before naming a number.
Bring whatever paperwork you have, even if incomplete.

faqs.question: Herminie was a coal town — do you buy oil and gas rights there too?
faqs.answer: Yes, oil and gas mineral rights are frequently a separate ownership interest from coal in former patch towns like Herminie, and that's specifically what we buy.

faqs.question: How do I know if my Herminie property's oil and gas rights were severed from coal?
faqs.answer: We review the recorded deed history to determine this as part of our process, so you don't need to have already sorted it out before reaching out.

faqs.question: Is there active drilling right around Herminie?
faqs.answer: Activity in this part of Westmoreland County is uneven and tract-specific, so we look at what's actually happening near your particular parcel rather than assuming based on the town.
